title: Dynamic networks of PTSD symptoms during conflict
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-person network
limitations: - Sample limited to civilians exposed to rocket fire; - Data collected during conflict, not post-exposure; - Methodological limitations of multilevel network model (no fit statistics, assumes stationarity); - Small sample size limited inclusion of covariates.
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. Code and data availability are not explicitly stated in the main text, but supplementary materials may contain them. The authors note limitations regarding sample generalizability and model assumptions.
